jaap|jaap039.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਸੰਭ is read as birthless or ungenerated, the sense Mahan Kosh explicitly associates with Jaap Sahib. Other commentary emphasises unmanifest or self-radiant being. The ordinary sense of impossible is not the selected meaning here.

jaap|jaap040.line01.simpleEn: You are beyond the full reach of our senses and understanding.
jaap|jaap040.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਮਨ ਅਤੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਰੂਪ ਤਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ।
jaap|jaap040.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਗੰਮ concerns what cannot be fully reached or fathomed. The line expresses the limit of ordinary grasp; it does not declare remembrance, learning or a loving relationship impossible.

jaap|jaap040.line02.simpleEn: You are birthless; Your being does not begin through birth.
jaap|jaap040.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਅਜਨਮਾ ਹੈਂ; ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਜਨਮ ਲੈਣ ਨਾਲ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।
jaap|jaap040.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਜੰਮ names freedom from birth. This is a Divine attribute, not a statement that a person can avoid ordinary birth and death simply by repeating the line.

jaap|jaap040.line03.simpleEn: You are not composed of the material elements of the world.
jaap|jaap040.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੇ ਭੌਤਿਕ ਤੱਤਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap040.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੂਤ is read as beyond material or elemental composition, consistently with the identical line in Chhand 34. Commentary also gives an unmanifest reading of this repeated epithet. The traditional five-element vocabulary is not a modern chemical model, and the word does not mean a ghost here.

jaap|jaap040.line04.simpleEn: You are beyond physical touch and cannot be grasped as a material object.
jaap|jaap040.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਛੋਹ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈਂ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਾਂਗ ਫੜਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap040.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਛੂਤ is explicitly glossed for Jaap Sahib in Mahan Kosh as beyond touch. This Divine epithet must be distinguished from the word’s harmful caste usage; it does not declare any people impure or unworthy of contact.

jaap|jaap041.line01.simpleEn: You are unseen, beyond the reach of ordinary sight.
jaap|jaap041.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਆਮ ਅੱਖੀਂ ਵੇਖਣ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap041.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਲੋਕ is read as unseen, as in the consulted Punjabi steek and Neki. Here it is not a dismissal of the world or a claim that particular visual experiences prove spiritual attainment.

jaap|jaap041.line02.simpleEn: You are free from sorrow; grief does not overwhelm Your being.
jaap|jaap041.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸੋਗ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ; ਦੁੱਖ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ।
jaap|jaap041.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਸੋਕ names freedom from sorrow. It addresses the Divine; it does not shame human grief or promise that a devoted person will never feel sadness.

jaap|jaap041.line03.simpleEn: You are not bound by actions and their karmic consequences.
jaap|jaap041.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕਰਮ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਫਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਦੇ।
jaap|jaap041.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਕਰਮ is read through freedom from karmic bondage. Some translations emphasise freedom from ritual obligation. Neither reading makes the Divine incapable of action or excuses a person from responsibility.

jaap|jaap041.line04.simpleEn: You are free from delusion and the confusion it brings.
jaap|jaap041.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਭਰਮ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਭੁਲੇਖੇ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap041.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭਰਮ denies delusion or confusion. It should not be turned into a prohibition on honest questions; the poem describes the One addressed rather than a rule against inquiry.

jaap|jaap042.line01.simpleEn: You cannot be conquered or overcome by another power.
jaap|jaap042.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਤਾਕਤ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਜਿੱਤ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap042.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਜੀਤ names the unconquerable One. The line does not transfer that quality to a reader’s body, status or personal conflicts.

jaap|jaap042.line02.simpleEn: You are fearless, not ruled by fear of another.
jaap|jaap042.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੈਂ; ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਦਾ ਡਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਚਲਾਉਂਦਾ।
jaap|jaap042.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੀਤ concerns fearlessness. It is paired with being unconquerable but names a distinct quality: fear and defeat are not the same thing.

jaap|jaap042.line03.simpleEn: You remain unshaken; no outside force can dislodge Your being.
jaap|jaap042.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਅਡੋਲ ਹੈਂ; ਕੋਈ ਬਾਹਰਲੀ ਤਾਕਤ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਡੁਲਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap042.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਬਾਹ is read as unmoving or unshakable, consistently supported by Neki, the Rampur Khera steek and the Bhai Vir Singh commentary. It is not read as a statement about lacking arms.

jaap|jaap042.line04.simpleEn: Your depth cannot be fully fathomed or measured.
jaap|jaap042.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਅਥਾਹ ਹੈਂ; ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਮਾਪੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap042.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਗਾਹ concerns unfathomable depth. Keep it distinct from ਅਬਾਹ: the first stresses steadiness, while this word points to the limit of reaching the full depth.

jaap|jaap043.line01.simpleEn: You are beyond measure; no scale can contain Your extent.
jaap|jaap043.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਮਿਣਤੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈਂ; ਕੋਈ ਮਾਪ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਵਿਸਥਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap043.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਮਾਨ is read as immeasurable, the sense Mahan Kosh explicitly associates with Jaap Sahib. Other dictionary senses involving dishonour, trust or safety are not selected for this line.

jaap|jaap043.line02.simpleEn: You are the treasury from which every kind of abundance comes.
jaap|jaap043.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਹਰ ਕਿਸਮ ਦੀ ਦਾਤ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨੇ ਦਾ ਸੋਮਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap043.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਨਿਧਾਨ supplies a treasury or storehouse image. In this praise it can include spiritual qualities and the gifts of existence; it is not a promise of money or possessions.

jaap|jaap043.line03.simpleEn: You are present through countless forms, appearing as many.
jaap|jaap043.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਅਨੇਕਾਂ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੀ ਵਿਆਪਕਤਾ ਦਿੱਸਦੀ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap043.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਨੇਕ points to multiplicity. The following ਫਿਰਿ ਏਕ must remain with it: this line is not treated as a separate claim that the many have displaced the One.

jaap|jaap043.line04.simpleEn: Yet through all that multiplicity, You remain One.
jaap|jaap043.line04.simplePa: ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ, ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਇੱਕੋ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap043.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਫਿਰਿ carries the return or contrast here: many, and still One. The frozen spelling ਫਿਰਿ is retained. The stanza does not describe a timetable in which separate gods later merge.

jaap|jaap044.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, worthy of honour throughout creation.
jaap|jaap044.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਜਗਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਤਿਕਾਰਯੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap044.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਮਾਨੇ gives honour a universal scope. This is devotional praise, not a survey claiming that every person consciously holds the same belief. A separate Bhujang Prayat heading precedes this stanza.

jaap|jaap044.line02.simpleEn: You are the source and treasury of all abundance.
jaap|jaap044.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਨਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap044.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਮਸਤੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੇ continues the preceding salutation through the treasury image. Its opening is not ਨਮੋ in the frozen line; the explanation follows the continuing address without inserting a word into the scripture.

jaap|jaap044.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, supreme even among those called divine.
jaap|jaap044.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਉੱਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap044.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵੇ is a repeated-word intensification, commonly explained as the Divine above the devas. The Bhai Vir Singh commentary emphasises the radiance that gives them light. It does not require a modern factual ranking of celestial beings.

jaap|jaap044.line04.simpleEn: You are not defined by an outward guise, and Your being is undivided.
jaap|jaap044.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਭੇਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੱਝਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap044.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੇਖੀ concerns outward guise. ਅਭੇਵੇ is provisionally read as without division or distinction, within the ਭੇਦ-ਰਹਿਤ reading of the Punjabi steek and Bhai Vir Singh commentary. Explanations involving absence of concealment or secrets also occur; these distinct senses remain for qualified review.

jaap|jaap045.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose sovereignty reaches even over death and time.
jaap|jaap045.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕਾਲ ਵੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਵੱਸ ਹੈ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap045.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਕਾਲ ਕਾਲੇ renews the earlier intensified address: the One beyond the authority of death and time. It is not a guarantee that the person reciting will escape mortality.

jaap|jaap045.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, who sustain and care for all beings.
jaap|jaap045.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap045.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਪਾਲੇ places universal care beside sovereignty over death. Both qualities address the same One; neither should be omitted when explaining this pair.

jaap|jaap045.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose presence extends everywhere.
jaap|jaap045.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap045.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਗਉਣੇ is read through pervading or moving throughout all places. The exact ਗਉਣੇ spelling is retained; its sense here should not be selected simply by resemblance to the modern Punjabi verb for singing.

jaap|jaap045.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, present throughout every realm and dwelling.
jaap|jaap045.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਭਵਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਟਿਕਾਣਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap045.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਭਉਣੇ reinforces presence in all places and realms. It is not limited to one building or shrine. Its overlap with the preceding line enriches the praise without requiring an artificial technical distinction.

jaap|jaap046.line01.simpleEn: You are without a physical body, and no other master rules over You.
jaap|jaap046.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਰੀਰ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਉੱਪਰ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਲਕ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap046.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਨੰਗੀ concerns the absence of bodily limbs; ਅਨਾਥੇ concerns having no ਨਾਥ, master, above the One. Both epithets belong to this line. The second is a statement of Divine independence, not the ordinary social condition of an abandoned or unsupported person.

jaap|jaap046.line02.simpleEn: You depend on no companion and hold the power that brings creation to its end.
jaap|jaap046.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਸਾਥੀ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਲ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap046.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਨ੍ਰਿਸੰਗੀ is read through freedom from a necessary companion. ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ is provisionally read as destructive or dissolving power, supported by Sant Sewa Singh and Neki. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived account instead develops a churning image. That alternative remains open; the main sentence does not turn the two words into a single title.

jaap|jaap046.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the radiance from which every sun receives its light.
jaap|jaap046.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਸੂਰਜ ਦਾ ਚਾਨਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਤੋਂ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap046.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਭਾਨ is the sun. The repeated ਭਾਨ ਭਾਨੇ construction directs praise through the image of a sun beyond suns; the explanation selects the source-of-radiance emphasis. This whole original line recurs at 47.02, where its main bilingual explanation is identical.

jaap|jaap046.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the honour of all who are honoured.
jaap|jaap046.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਮਾਣ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap046.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਮਾਨ ਮਾਨੇ intensifies honour and reverence. It is read here as the One to whom even the honoured owe reverence, not as praise of personal arrogance. The same wording is used at 56.02; a bestower-of-honour emphasis also appears in Neki’s rendering there.

jaap|jaap047.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose gentle radiance shines through every moon.
jaap|jaap047.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਚੰਦ ਦੀ ਠੰਢੀ ਰੌਸ਼ਨੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੀ ਜੋਤ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap047.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰੇ repeats the moon image to direct praise toward its supreme source. Coolness and gentle radiance follow the Punjabi commentary’s devotional emphasis. These are poetic associations of moonlight, not an explanation of how a physical moon produces or reflects light.

jaap|jaap047.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the radiance from which every sun receives its light.
jaap|jaap047.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਸੂਰਜ ਦਾ ਚਾਨਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਤੋਂ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap047.line02.interpretiveCaution: This is the exact original line already encountered at 46.03. Keeping the main explanation unchanged makes the repetition visible: the same sun image now stands immediately beside moon, song and melody. Context adds a relation without changing the word ਭਾਨ into a new epithet.

jaap|jaap047.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the song at the heart of every song.
jaap|jaap047.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਗੀਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਮਿਠਾਸ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap047.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਗੀਤ ਗੀਤੇ uses the same repeated-noun pattern as the celestial images. Song becomes a way of praising the One as its inner essence and delight. The line names no particular song, singer or musical tradition as an exclusive dwelling of the Divine.

jaap|jaap047.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the melody within every melody.
jaap|jaap047.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਸੁਰਿਲੀ ਧੁਨ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap047.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਤਾਨ is selected in its musical sense, supported by the adjacent ਗੀਤ, Sant Sewa Singh, Neki and the historical dictionary’s account of melodic movement. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived page gives power and instrument alternatives. Those are recorded rather than silently merged with the selected melody reading.

jaap|jaap048.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the living rhythm of every dance.
jaap|jaap048.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਨਾਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਦੀ ਲੈ ਤੈਥੋਂ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap048.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਨ੍ਰਿੱਤ is read through dance and movement. Neki retains the dance image, while Sant Sewa Singh relates it to the movement of the world; the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account develops bliss and churning associations. The main explanation keeps the dance image without prescribing a performance. The frozen addak in ਨ੍ਰਿੱਤ is preserved.

jaap|jaap048.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the resonance at the heart of every sound.
jaap|jaap048.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਨਾਦ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਗੂੰਜਦਾ ਸੁਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap048.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਨਾਦ concerns sound or resonance. The repeated ਨਾਦ ਨਾਦੇ carries praise through that image, following the dance line. It does not name one required pitch, an audible inner phenomenon or a test of the reader’s spiritual progress.

jaap|jaap048.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the strength within all hands.
jaap|jaap048.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੇ ਹੱਥਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਦਾ ਮੂਲ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap048.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਪਾਨ is provisionally read as hand, supported by Sant Sewa Singh, the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account and Mahan Kosh’s ਪਾਣਿ/ਹੱਥ sense. Neki instead gives a drum-beating image. The dictionary also lists unrelated homonyms, including drinking; they should not be substituted automatically. The original ਪਾਨ spelling is unchanged.

jaap|jaap048.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the music voiced through every instrument.
jaap|jaap048.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਸਾਜ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਗੂੰਜਦੀ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਦੀ ਧੁਨ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap048.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਬਾਦ is read through ਵਾਦਯ, instrumental sound, following the musical context and the consulted commentaries. It is not taken here as the ordinary homonym for a quarrel. The pair praises the One through the sounding of instruments without naming a required instrument or method.

jaap|jaap049.line01.simpleEn: You are without bodily limbs, and no single name can contain You.
jaap|jaap049.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਰੀਰ ਦੇ ਅੰਗਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਇੱਕ ਨਾਮ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਿਆਨ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap049.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਨੰਗੀ repeats the body-free title; ਅਨਾਮੇ adds namelessness. The explanation treats namelessness as the inability of a fixed descriptive name to exhaust the One. It does not deny the devotional remembrance of Naam, nor omit the first of the two epithets.

jaap|jaap049.line02.simpleEn: You are present in all the forms of creation.
jaap|jaap049.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap049.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਮਸਤੀ ਸਰੂਪੇ is a connected phrase concerning all forms, not two unrelated titles. Beside ਅਨੰਗੀ, it places pervasion of forms alongside freedom from a single body. The wording preserves that tension rather than claiming that the first line has been withdrawn.

jaap|jaap049.line03.simpleEn: You break apart what has been formed and bring it to an end.
jaap|jaap049.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਬਣੇ ਹੋਏ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੰਗ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap049.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਪ੍ਰਭੰਗੀ and ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ are both retained in this account of breaking and dissolution. Their overlap is not evidence that one may be skipped. The selected reading follows the Punjabi steek’s destruction emphasis; the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account distinguishes a breaking title from a churning title. The latter remains a real alternative.

jaap|jaap049.line04.simpleEn: All the abundance and splendour of creation rest in You.
jaap|jaap049.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap049.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਬਿਭੂਤੇ is read through abundance, wealth and splendour; ਸਮਸਤੀ extends the phrase to all. Mahan Kosh distinguishes the wealth sense of ਬਿਭੂਤ from its ash-related homonym. Sant Sewa Singh stresses the treasury of all things, while Neki stresses the source of wealth. No material reward is promised to the reader.

jaap|jaap050.line01.simpleEn: Your being is entirely unstained; no blemish attaches to You.
jaap|jaap050.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ; ਕੋਈ ਕਲੰਕ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗਦਾ।
jaap|jaap050.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਕਲੰਕੰ ਬਿਨਾ and ਨੇਕਲੰਕੀ reinforce one another: absence of blemish and unstained being. The whole phrase occupies one line. In this context, ਨੇਕਲੰਕੀ is not used to identify a particular Kalki incarnation or to replace the frozen spelling with another edition’s form.

jaap|jaap050.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the sovereign over every ruler, whose being is supreme.
jaap|jaap050.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਮਹਾਰਾਜਾ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਪਰਮ ਮਹਾਨ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap050.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜੇਸ੍ਵਰੰ and ਪਰਮ ਰੂਪੇ both belong to this line. The first places kings beneath Divine sovereignty; the second praises supreme being or form. Sant Sewa Singh brings out radiance, while Neki brings out supreme existence. The main paraphrase avoids reducing ਰੂਪ to bodily appearance.

jaap|jaap051.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, master of the masters of yoga and supreme in spiritual perfection.
jaap|jaap051.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਵੱਡੇ ਯੋਗੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਮਾਲਕ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਪੂਰਨਤਾ ਦਾ ਸਰਬੋਤਮ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap051.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੇਸ੍ਵਰੰ names mastery beyond the masters of yoga; ਪਰਮ ਸਿੱਧੇ adds supreme perfection or accomplishment. The Punjabi steek also emphasises mastery over siddhis. The draft keeps both clauses without claiming that the Divine had to acquire perfection through a bodily practice or that a reader will gain extraordinary powers.

jaap|jaap051.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, ruler over all rulers, whose greatness is unsurpassed.
jaap|jaap051.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਮਹਾਰਾਜਾ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਹਾਨਤਾ ਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਾਨੀ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap051.line02.interpretiveCaution: The kingship phrase recurs from Chhand 50, but the ending is now ਪਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਿਧੇ. Sant Sewa Singh and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account emphasise greatness; Neki emphasises esteem. The selected sense is eminence, not the age of a Divine body. The frozen ਬ੍ਰਿਧੇ is retained despite a comparator commentary’s ਬ੍ਰਿੱਧੇ spelling.

jaap|jaap052.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the bearer of weapons.
jaap|jaap052.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸ਼ਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap052.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਣੇ presents a martial image of weapons borne in the hand. ਪਾਣੇ supplies the hand-bearing element. ਸਸਤ੍ਰ is a broad weapons term; it need not exclude the projected weapons named in the next line. This is a salutation to Divine power, not an instruction to arm or attack.

jaap|jaap052.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, who wield weapons that are sent forth.
jaap|jaap052.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap052.line02.interpretiveCaution: Mahan Kosh distinguishes ਅਸਤ੍ਰ as a weapon projected or cast forth. Sant Sewa Singh explains the compound through using such weapons, while Neki stresses their projection. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived account develops an arrow-of-wisdom interpretation. That metaphor remains an attributed alternative, not a replacement of the martial wording.

jaap|jaap052.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose knowing is complete.
jaap|jaap052.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਜਾਣਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap052.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਪਰਮ ਗਿਆਤਾ praises supreme knowing. It adds discernment to the preceding power images rather than naming another weapon. The frozen ਗਿਆਤਾ spelling is retained; a consulted commentary prints ਗਯਾਤਾ, which is recorded as that witness’s form rather than a correction.

jaap|jaap052.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the Mother who gives life and care to the world.
jaap|jaap052.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਜਗਤ ਦੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap052.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਲੋਕ ਮਾਤਾ directly introduces the world’s Mother. The draft retains this maternal form of address and draws out its life-giving care. It is not a claim that the Divine is exclusively male or female, nor a restriction of human caregiving to women. The same One receives all four salutations.

jaap|jaap053.line01.simpleEn: You have no defining garb and are free from delusion; You do not depend on worldly enjoyment and cannot be made an object of enjoyment.
jaap|jaap053.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਭੇਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਭਰਮ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ; ਤੂੰ ਭੋਗਾਂ ਦਾ ਮੁਥਾਜ ਨਹੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਭੋਗ ਦੀ ਵਸਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap053.line01.interpretiveCaution: The four epithets are kept distinct: ਅਭੇਖੀ concerns garb, ਅਭਰਮੀ delusion, ਅਭੋਗੀ worldly indulgence, and ਅਭੁਗਤੇ being enjoyed or consumed. The final phrase is a working paraphrase of the non-enjoyed sense in Punjabi commentary. Neki instead emphasises detachment and freedom from temptation. This address does not condemn human bodies or every form of joy.

jaap|jaap053.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, supreme master of the yogis, whose way is complete.
jaap|jaap053.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਜੋਗੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵੀ ਮਹਾਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜੁਗਤ ਵਾਲੇ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap053.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗੇਸ੍ਵਰੰ honours the Divine above masters of spiritual discipline. ਪਰਮ ਜੁਗਤੇ is provisionally read as supreme in method or wisdom of practice, following Punjabi commentary. A complete-union reading also occurs; Mahan Kosh includes both method and union within the related ਜੁਗਤਿ vocabulary. Neither reading supplies a physical yoga technique.

jaap|jaap054.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the enduring Narayan who sustains life and acts with fearsome power.
jaap|jaap054.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ, ਜੀਵਨ ਨੂੰ ਆਸਰਾ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਭਿਆਨਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap054.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਨਿੱਤ gives the enduring sense; ਨਾਰਾਇਣੇ is a Divine name associated here with sustaining care. ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਰਮੇ retains the unsettling force of fierce or terrible action, including destruction, rather than turning it into gentle action alone. This is praise addressed to the Divine, not permission for human cruelty. The consulted texts differ between ਕ੍ਰੂਰ and ਕਰੂਰ; this explanation keeps the original wording.

jaap|jaap054.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the Divine light of the departed and the living, whose dharam is noble.
jaap|jaap054.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਮਰ ਚੁੱਕਿਆਂ ਤੇ ਜੀਉਂਦਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਤੇ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਧਰਮ ਵਾਲੇ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap054.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਪ੍ਰੇਤ/ਅਪ੍ਰੇਤ is provisionally heard as departed/not-departed, following one commentary’s contrast. Mahan Kosh supports departed as a sense of ਪ੍ਰੇਤ; it does not independently establish this whole paired reading. The Rampur Khera steek gives unsettled spirits and pure souls; another gloss contrasts inanimate and conscious being. ਦੇਵੇ is heard as Divine light and ਸੁਧਰਮੇ as excellent dharam. These alternatives remain open, without changing the text or treating spirit language as a diagnosis.

jaap|jaap055.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, praised as the remover of illness and suffering.
jaap|jaap055.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਰੋਗ ਅਤੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap055.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਰੋਗ ਹਰਤਾ is devotional praise of the remover of affliction. It is not a promise that recitation will cure a condition or proof that ongoing illness reflects weak faith. The consulted texts differ in punctuation and line grouping here; this explanation follows the four lines as presented.

jaap|jaap055.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose being is love.
jaap|jaap055.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪਿਆਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap055.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਰਾਗ is read as love or affection, supported by Punjabi commentary and the Mahan Kosh entry. Neki and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived commentary emphasise bliss here. The word also has musical senses, but this line does not prescribe a particular raag or make musical ability a condition of devotion.

jaap|jaap055.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, sovereign over every sovereign.
jaap|jaap055.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸ਼ਾਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਵੀ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap055.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹੰ is the repeated royal title, heard as Shah of shahs. In this context ਸਾਹ does not mean a breathing exercise. The spelling in the original is retained even though explanatory Punjabi commonly writes ਸ਼ਾਹ.

jaap|jaap055.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, ruler over all earthly rulers.
jaap|jaap055.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap055.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਭੂਪ ਭੂਪੇ repeats the language of rulers to place human authority beneath the Divine. It does not make any present ruler, institution or community exempt from moral responsibility.

jaap|jaap056.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the giver from whom all givers receive.
jaap|jaap056.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਦਾਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਦਾਤੇ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap056.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਦਾਨ ਦਾਨੇ is read as the giver of givers, supported by the Punjabi commentaries. The repeated expression places generosity in relation to its Divine source rather than measuring a person’s worth by the amount they donate.

jaap|jaap056.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the honour of all who are honoured.
jaap|jaap056.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੇ ਮਾਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਮਾਣ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap056.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਮਾਨ ਮਾਨੇ has the same selected English and Punjabi explanation as its occurrence in Chhand 46. The honour-of-the-honoured reading follows Punjabi commentary; bestower of honour is another rendering. Honour here need not mean social rank or pride.

jaap|jaap056.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, praised as the affliction that overcomes afflictions.
jaap|jaap056.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਰੋਗਾਂ ਲਈ ਵੀ ਰੋਗ ਬਣ ਕੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਟਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap056.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਰੋਗ ਰੋਗੇ uses the striking disease-of-disease expression. This draft selects the destroyer-of-affliction reading found in Punjabi commentary and Neki. A Rampur Khera footnote instead stresses that even diseases receive their power within Divine sovereignty; that is a distinct interpretation. Neither reading makes illness a person’s fault or promises a particular medical outcome.

jaap|jaap056.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, source of purity, praised through the image of a cleansing bath.
jaap|jaap056.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰਤਾ ਦੇ ਸੋਮੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਇਸ਼ਨਾਨ ਵਾਂਗ ਯਾਦ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap056.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸਨਾਨੇ is heard through bathing and purification imagery, supported by Punjabi commentary and the related dictionary entry ਇਸਨਾਨ. Neki’s health-focused rendering is not adopted as a medical claim. Some other witnesses print ਇਸਨਾਨੰ; the original ਸਨਾਨੇ remains unchanged. The source comparison also notes differences in punctuation and grouping, without replacing the original words.

jaap|jaap057.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You as the mantra of mantras, supreme over sacred formulas.
jaap|jaap057.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਰੂਪ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap057.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ can name a sacred utterance, formula or counsel. The repeated ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ is an address of supremacy in this context. It gives no recitation count, operational formula or guarantee that a desired event will occur.

jaap|jaap057.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You as the yantra of yantras, supreme over ritual devices and diagrams.
jaap|jaap057.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਜੰਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਰੂਪ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਕੋਈ ਰਸਮੀ ਸਾਧਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡਾ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap057.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਜੰਤ੍ਰ has several dictionary senses, including device, instrument and ritual diagram or talisman. The pairing with mantra and tantra supports the ritual-device sense selected here. The lesson does not claim that diagrams, amulets or objects control the Divine, and it does not substitute the unrelated living-creature sense.

jaap|jaap057.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the One worthy of worship even by those whom others worship.
jaap|jaap057.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲੋਕ ਪੂਜਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਵੀ ਪੂਜਣਯੋਗ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap057.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਇਸਟ is read as a cherished or worship-worthy object of devotion; ਇਸਟ ਇਸਟੇ places the Divine above all such objects of worship. It is a reverent superlative, not an instruction to insult other people’s religious practice.

jaap|jaap057.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You as the tantra of tantras, supreme over ritual systems and techniques.
jaap|jaap057.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਤੰਤ੍ਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਰੂਪ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਰਸਮੀ ਵਿਧੀਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap057.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਤੰਤ੍ਰ can mean a system, method or ritual practice, among other senses. In this sequence the working reading concerns methods associated with ritual power. The phrase praises the One; it is not a recipe, endorsement of coercive magic or promise of special abilities.

jaap|jaap058.line01.simpleEn: You are eternally true being, awareness and bliss, and the One who brings all created things to their end.
jaap|jaap058.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ ਸੱਚੀ ਹੋਂਦ, ਚੇਤਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ; ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਵੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap058.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਸੱਚਦਾਨੰਦ is conventionally explained through sat, chit and anand: true being, consciousness and bliss. ਸਰਬੰ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਸੀ names the ending of all, not merely the removal of bad habits. This reading follows the consulted commentaries without silently expanding the source spelling or making a prediction about when the world will end.

jaap|jaap058.line02.simpleEn: You are beyond comparison and without form, yet dwell within all.
jaap|jaap058.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ; ਤੂੰ ਰੂਪ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap058.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਨੂਪੇ denies an adequate comparison, ਅਰੂਪੇ a bounded form, and ਸਮਸਤੁਲ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ affirms presence within all. These are three distinct claims in one source line. Another website prints ਸਮਸਤੁਲਿ; this text’s ਸਮਸਤੁਲ is retained. Divine presence does not mean every human action is approved.

jaap|jaap059.line01.simpleEn: You always grant spiritual attainment and understanding, and bring about growth.
jaap|jaap059.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੱਧੀ ਅਤੇ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਧਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap059.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਸਿਧਦਾ and ਬੁਧਦਾ are provisionally read as granting attainment and understanding; ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਕਰਤਾ as bringing increase or growth. Another consulted text reads ਸਿਧਿਦਾ ਬੁਧਿਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧਿ. The commentary-supported compound reading does not settle that spelling question. Traditional siddhi can include extraordinary accomplishments or powers; this draft does not promise them to a reader.

jaap|jaap059.line02.simpleEn: You are present below, above and between, and remove the gathered burden of wrongdoing.
jaap|jaap059.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਹੇਠਾਂ, ਉੱਪਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈਂ; ਪਾਪਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਮੂਹ ਨੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap059.line02.interpretiveCaution: This selects the Rampur Khera spatial reading of ਅਧੋ ਉਰਧ ਅਰਧੰ, followed by ਅਘੰ ਓਘ as an accumulation of wrongdoing and ਹਰਤਾ as remover. Another Punjabi commentary instead relates the three descriptors to classes or degrees of wrongdoing. The alternatives are not merged into a fabricated single explanation. Removing wrongdoing is not permission to avoid responsibility for harm.

jaap|jaap060.line01.simpleEn: You are the supreme Lord, higher than every greatness, who sustains all while remaining unseen.
jaap|jaap060.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਸ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਟ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ਰ, ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਪ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ।
jaap|jaap060.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਪਰੰ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰੰ intensifies the address to the supreme Lord. ਪ੍ਰੋਛ ਪਾਲੰ is read as unseen or hidden sustenance, supported by Punjabi commentary and Neki. This contextual explanation does not claim a settled derivation of ਪ੍ਰੋਛ. Unseen describes the Divine mode of care, not the worth of people with different visual abilities.

jaap|jaap060.line02.simpleEn: You are forever merciful, the giver of spiritual attainments at every time.
jaap|jaap060.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਦਿਆਲੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੱਧੀਆਂ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap060.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬਦਾ reinforces continuity; ਦਿਆਲੰ names mercy. ਸਿੱਧ ਦਾਤਾ is provisionally read with the commentaries as bestower of siddhi, including traditional spiritual accomplishments or powers. Another consulted text prints ਸਿਧਿ ਦਾਤਾ; the original ਸਿੱਧ ਦਾਤਾ is unchanged and the edition question remains open. The line is not a guarantee that every wish or practice produces an extraordinary result.

jaap|jaap061.line01.simpleEn: You cannot be cut or pierced; no name confines You and no craving governs You.
jaap|jaap061.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਾ ਕੱਟਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਵਿੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ; ਕੋਈ ਨਾਮ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਚਲਾਉਂਦੀ।
jaap|jaap061.line01.interpretiveCaution: The line holds four distinct titles: ਅਛੇਦੀ, uncut; ਅਭੇਦੀ, unpierced; ਅਨਾਮੰ, nameless; and ਅਕਾਮੰ, free from desire. The first pair uses images of physical penetration, while the second concerns naming and desire. The explanation of namelessness follows the earlier distinction between a devotional name and a description that could exhaust the One.

jaap|jaap061.line02.simpleEn: You bring all into being and dwell throughout all.
jaap|jaap061.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap061.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਮਸਤੋ ਪਰਾਜੀ is provisionally read through bringing all into being, following Sant Sewa Singh and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account. Neki instead reads overcoming every power. That is a substantive alternative, not an interchangeable gloss. ਸਮਸਤਸਤੁ ਧਾਮੰ adds dwelling throughout all; both parts of the line remain present in the main explanation.

jaap|jaap062.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap062.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋਰੁ is a brief invocation accompanying the transition to Chachari metre. Its words acknowledge Your strength; the selected explanation draws out reliance on that strength, as in Sant Sewa Singh. Neki gives a by-Your-power emphasis, while the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account frames an appeal for help. The metre name is a separate heading.

jaap|jaap062.line02.simpleEn: You are present in the waters.
jaap|jaap062.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਜਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap062.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਜਲੇ is read from ਜਲ, water, with ਹੈਂ directly addressing the One. The word does not mean burning in this context. Read it with the following land image: the pair extends attention across different settings without dividing Divine presence into separate beings.

jaap|jaap062.line03.simpleEn: You are present throughout the land.
jaap|jaap062.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਧਰਤੀ ਉੱਤੇ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap062.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਥਲੇ is read through land or dry ground beside ਜਲੇ. The Punjabi commentary includes arid land in that scope. The pair is not a claim that the Divine resides only below something, nor a boundary between places where the One can and cannot be found.

jaap|jaap062.line04.simpleEn: You are free from fear of any other power.
jaap|jaap062.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਤਾਕਤ ਦਾ ਡਰ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap062.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੀਤ retains the fearlessness sense already selected at Chhand 31, with the same main explanation. Sant Sewa Singh and Neki support that reading here. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived account instead stresses not causing fear; the two directions of fear should not be silently treated as identical.

jaap|jaap062.line05.simpleEn: Your full mystery cannot be fathomed.
jaap|jaap062.line05.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap062.line05.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੇ keeps the unfathomable-mystery reading used at Chhand 31. Sant Sewa Singh’s explanation and Neki’s rendering of this chhand support it. A fearlessness reading occurs in the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account. Keeping the selected sense distinct from the preceding ਅਭੀਤ helps preserve the final pair’s different emphases.

jaap|jaap063.line01.simpleEn: You are the sovereign Lord of all.
jaap|jaap063.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਦਾ ਮਾਲਕ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap063.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ is a title of lordship and sovereignty. After the preceding chhand’s address across water and land, this line states the relationship directly. It does not assign that supreme status to a human officeholder.

jaap|jaap063.line02.simpleEn: You are birthless; Your being does not begin with a birth.
jaap|jaap063.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਅਜਨਮਾ ਹੈਂ; ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਕਿਸੇ ਜਨਮ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।
jaap|jaap063.line02.interpretiveCaution: The exact ਅਜੂ ਹੈਂ phrase already appears at Chhand 29, whose main explanation is retained. Sant Sewa Singh supports freedom from birth here. Mahan Kosh also records motionlessness, the emphasis followed by Neki and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account. Birthlessness and immutability are related theological descriptions, but they are not the same lexical claim.

jaap|jaap063.line03.simpleEn: No single place or country can contain You.
jaap|jaap063.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕੋਈ ਇੱਕ ਥਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਸ਼ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap063.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਦੇਸ removes confinement to a particular ਦੇਸ, place or country. Read beside presence in water and land, it does not mean the One is simply absent. The same theme will be expressed positively through ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੇ, all lands, in Chhand 66.

jaap|jaap063.line04.simpleEn: No particular outward guise defines You.
jaap|jaap063.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਭੇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਝਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap063.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੇਸ concerns freedom from a defining ਭੇਸ, guise or attire. It does not single out a garment or a community’s appearance for rejection. The later ਸਰਬ ਭੇਸੇ, all guises, expands the relation to visible forms without making one appearance an exhaustive definition.

jaap|jaap064.line01.simpleEn: Your depth cannot be fathomed, and nothing can obstruct You.
jaap|jaap064.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਥਾਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਈ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਰੁਕਾਵਟ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਰੋਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap064.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਗਾਧੇ and ਅਬਾਧੇ are both explained. The first concerns depth beyond fathoming; the second is provisionally read as unhindered, following Neki. Sant Sewa Singh and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account emphasise freedom from destruction for ਅਬਾਧੇ. That alternative should remain distinct from the selected obstruction-related sense.

jaap|jaap064.line02.simpleEn: Your very being is complete joy.
jaap|jaap064.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਹੋਂਦ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਨੰਦ ਦਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap064.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਨੰਦੀ ਸਰੂਪੇ joins joy or bliss with the One’s very being. It is a connected description, not a claim that ਸਰੂਪ requires a physical body. Beside the opening pair, the verse moves from limits that do not apply to the One toward an affirmative quality of Divine presence.

jaap|jaap064.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, worthy of honour throughout creation.
jaap|jaap064.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਜਗਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਤਿਕਾਰਯੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap064.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਨਮੋ ਸਰਬ ਮਾਨੇ repeats the line already encountered at Chhand 44, and its main explanation is unchanged. ਸਰਬ gives reverence a universal scope. The expression praises worthiness of honour without claiming that every person consciously holds the same beliefs.

jaap|jaap064.line04.simpleEn: You are the source and treasury of all abundance.
jaap|jaap064.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਨਿਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap064.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸਮਸਤੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੇ returns to the treasury image from Chhand 44, with the same main explanation. The address continues even though this line does not repeat ਨਮੋ. Abundance is praised through its source; no particular wealth or reward is promised to the reader.

jaap|jaap065.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, who have no master above You.
jaap|jaap065.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੇਰੇ ਉੱਪਰ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਮਾਲਕ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap065.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਨ੍ਰਿਨਾਥੇ is selected as without a superior master, supported by Sant Sewa Singh, Neki and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account. Mahan Kosh also lists a ruler-of-people sense for ਨ੍ਰਿਨਾਥ. The selected negative construction describes Divine independence, not the abandonment of a vulnerable person.

jaap|jaap065.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose power brings creation to its end.
jaap|jaap065.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਲ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap065.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ returns to the dissolution title encountered in Chhands 46 and 49. Sant Sewa Singh and Neki support a destructive sense here; the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account again uses churning. The main explanation retains the selected dissolution sense without presenting the alternative as settled.

jaap|jaap065.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, whom nothing can destroy.
jaap|jaap065.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਕੋਈ ਤਾਕਤ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap065.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਗੰਜੇ concerns freedom from destruction in the selected Punjabi and Bhai Vir Singh-derived readings. Neki emphasises being unconquered. The placement after ਪ੍ਰਮਾਥੇ matters: the One associated with the ending of created things is not presented as another thing awaiting the same destruction.

jaap|jaap065.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, who cannot be broken or divided apart.
jaap|jaap065.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੈਨੂੰ ਤੋੜਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਟੁਕੜਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap065.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੰਜੇ uses the image of not being broken. It complements ਅਗੰਜੇ while keeping its own emphasis on unbrokenness. The image does not require the One to be a physical object made from unusually strong material.

jaap|jaap066.line01.simpleEn: A salutation to the Timeless One.
jaap|jaap066.line01.interpretiveCaution: This is the same ਨਮਸਤ੍ਵੰ ਅਕਾਲੇ line heard at Chhand 2, so its main explanation is retained. ਅਕਾਲੇ reaches beyond time and death. Here the title leads into independence from nurture and presence throughout lands and guises.

jaap|jaap066.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, who need no one else to nourish or sustain You.
jaap|jaap066.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਲਈ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਆਸਰੇ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap066.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਪਾਲੇ is selected through freedom from needing another’s nurture, supported by the commentaries and Mahan Kosh. The dictionary also records a boundless sense, reflected in a Bhai Vir Singh-derived note. The chosen meaning concerns Divine independence, not a judgement against receiving care.

jaap|jaap066.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, present throughout every land.
jaap|jaap066.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਹਰ ਦੇਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap066.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੇ affirms presence across all lands. Read with ਅਦੇਸ in Chhand 63, it develops the distinction between having no exclusive country and being present everywhere. It does not assign the Divine to one nation or endorse every action of a state.

jaap|jaap066.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, present through every form and guise.
jaap|jaap066.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਭੇਸਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap066.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਭੇਸੇ extends the address through all guises or appearances. Its relation to ਅਭੇਸ in Chhand 63 is deliberate: no particular appearance exhausts the One, while the range of appearances is not excluded from Divine presence.

jaap|jaap067.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the King above every king.
jaap|jaap067.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap067.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜੇ intensifies the royal image by placing kingship beneath the One addressed. It continues the poem’s repeated-noun pattern of praise. The image concerns Divine sovereignty and does not turn an earthly ruler into its equal.

jaap|jaap067.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the Maker of all that is made.
jaap|jaap067.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਰਚਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap067.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜੇ is read through making, forming and ordering creation, supported by the consulted commentaries. The context differs from the instrumental ਬਾਦ image earlier in the bani; a familiar modern use of ਸਾਜ for a musical instrument should not decide this phrase on its own.

jaap|jaap067.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the Shah above every shah.
jaap|jaap067.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸ਼ਾਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap067.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਸ਼ਾਹ is a Persian royal title. The repeated phrase renews sovereignty in another part of the bani’s vocabulary. It is not a breathing instruction or a use of ਸਾਹ as breath; the established source form here is ਸ਼ਾਹ.

jaap|jaap067.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the light that makes every moon radiant.
jaap|jaap067.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਚੰਦ ਨੂੰ ਰੌਸ਼ਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਜੋਤ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap067.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਮਾਹ is selected as moon, with an explicit Jaap citation in Mahan Kosh and support from the commentaries. Other uses of the word, including month, do not govern this phrase. The moon-of-moons image directs praise through radiance and beauty; the main explanation remains devotional rather than astronomical.

jaap|jaap068.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the song at the heart of every song.
jaap|jaap068.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਗੀਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਮਿਠਾਸ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap068.line01.interpretiveCaution: This is the same original line as 47.03, and its main explanation is unchanged. The repeated ਗੀਤ praises the One as the essence of song. Here its neighbours move from love to fierce power and dissolution, giving the familiar line a different setting without changing its central image.

jaap|jaap068.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the deepest love within every love.
jaap|jaap068.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਦਾ ਡੂੰਘਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap068.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੇ intensifies the language of love, as the preceding line intensifies song. Punjabi commentary also expresses this as the supreme loving One among all who love. Another consulted text has ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ in the first position; the source spelling ਪ੍ਰੀਤ remains unchanged, with the shared love sense selected provisionally.

jaap|jaap068.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the supreme force of fierce resolve.
jaap|jaap068.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਜੋਸ਼ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਸ਼ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap068.line03.interpretiveCaution: Mahan Kosh cites this exact line under martial ardour or ਜੋਸ਼, while also listing anger among the senses of ਰੋਖ. Sant Sewa Singh joins fierce feeling with great ardour; Neki emphasises wrath. The main explanation selects forceful resolve, not uncontrolled personal anger. The praise does not authorise a reader to threaten or harm anyone.

jaap|jaap068.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the supreme power that draws all creation into dissolution.
jaap|jaap068.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਮੇਟ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਪਰਮ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap068.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸੋਖ carries the image of drying or absorption, not the word ਸੁਖ for comfort. The repeated form heightens that image. The selected explanation follows the Punjabi reading of gathering creation into dissolution; Neki retains drought imagery, and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived commentary speaks of drying even dryness. These are related poetic readings, not identical literal glosses.

jaap|jaap069.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose all-encompassing reality includes every illness.
jaap|jaap069.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੇ ਰੋਗ ਵੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਬ-ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹਸਤੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ।
jaap|jaap069.line01.interpretiveCaution: The Punjabi steeks describe ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗੇ as taking the form of all illness; Neki renders a source of ailments. The main explanation keeps illness within the passage’s universal address without claiming to diagnose why someone is ill. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived page also gives a breaking or removing sense. This is different wording from ਰੋਗ ਹਰਤਾ in Chhand 55 and promises no clinical cure.

jaap|jaap069.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the One who enjoys all creation.
jaap|jaap069.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਭੋਗਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap069.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਭੋਗੇ turns from the preceding illness image toward enjoyment or experience. Punjabi commentary selects the One who enjoys all; another emphasis is the form of bliss. The explanation preserves this positive enjoyment language rather than making it identical to the freedom from dependence on pleasure described in Chhand 53.

jaap|jaap069.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the One who prevails over all.
jaap|jaap069.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਜਿੱਤਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap069.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਤੰ places every finite power within Divine sovereignty. The wording concerns the One addressed in praise. It does not identify a human ruler, army, nation or reader as entitled to conquer other people.

jaap|jaap069.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, whose majesty fills all with awe and fear.
jaap|jaap069.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਮਹਾਨਤਾ ਸਭ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਭੈ ਅਤੇ ਅਦਬ ਜਗਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap069.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਭੀਤੰ is read here as giving fear, as the Punjabi commentaries state; Neki chooses awe. It is not the fearlessness epithet ਅਭੀਤ encountered elsewhere. Awe and fear retain the recognition of a power greater than oneself without making intimidation by a person a spiritual duty.

jaap|jaap070.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the source and fullness of all knowledge.
jaap|jaap070.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਾਰੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਸਰੋਤ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap070.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬ ਗਿਆਨੰ praises comprehensive knowledge. The Punjabi witnesses describe the Divine as knowledge itself or as its giver; the main explanation brings those close emphases together. It does not claim that any learner, teacher or institution possesses complete knowledge.

jaap|jaap070.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the supreme strength.
jaap|jaap070.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap070.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਤਾਨ is selected in its strength sense here, following the Punjabi steeks and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived explanation. Bhai Maya Singh’s dictionary also lists power under ਤਾਨ. This differs from the musical ਤਾਨ ਤਾਨੇ beside song in Chhand 47. Neki’s all-attracting reading remains a separate alternative; it is not silently substituted for the selected strength sense.

jaap|jaap070.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, the source and substance of every mantra.
jaap|jaap070.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਮੰਤਰ ਦਾ ਮੂਲ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap070.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ brings the vocabulary of sacred utterance, spiritual instruction or formula into the praise of the One. The Punjabi steeks retain the all-mantra form, while the Bhai Vir Singh-derived commentary stresses knowledge and devotional utterance. The line gives no formula for controlling events, curing illness or gaining power over anyone.

jaap|jaap070.line04.simpleEn: I bow to You, the power at work through every instrument and means.
jaap|jaap070.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰ ਜੰਤਰ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਧਨ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap070.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਜੰਤ੍ਰੰ is kept distinct from the preceding spoken or taught ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ. Mahan Kosh includes instruments, devices and ritual uses within ਜੰਤ੍ਰ. The selected means-related explanation follows the Bhai Vir Singh-derived account, alongside the Punjabi steeks’ all-jantra wording. Neki emphasises spells. Naming that historical vocabulary does not establish magical effects or make a technique capable of possessing the Divine.

jaap|jaap071.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, who behold all.
jaap|jaap071.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap071.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਦ੍ਰਿੱਸੰ is explained by the Punjabi steeks as seeing all; the Bhai Vir Singh-derived page adds the sense of looking after all. The devotional image expresses comprehensive awareness. It is not a statement that a person with physical sight has greater spiritual worth than someone without it.

jaap|jaap071.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, who draw all toward Yourself.
jaap|jaap071.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਵੱਲ ਖਿੱਚਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap071.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਕ੍ਰਿੱਸੰ is read as drawing or attracting all, supported by both Punjabi steeks and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived commentary. Neki instead uses supreme power. The main explanation selects attraction without constructing an unsupported word origin or replacing the source epithet with a different proper name.

jaap|jaap071.line03.simpleEn: I bow to You, present through every colour and delight.
jaap|jaap071.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰੇ ਰੰਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਅਤੇ ਅਨੰਦ ਦਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap071.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਰੰਗੇ allows the Punjabi commentaries to speak both of the many colours of creation and of delight or bliss. The explanation keeps those related images together. Divine presence across variety is not a ranking of human complexions, bodies or ways of perceiving colour.

jaap|jaap071.line04.simpleEn: You are the bodiless One who brings the three worlds to their end.
jaap|jaap071.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ, ਤੂੰ ਤਿੰਨਾਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਆਪ ਕਿਸੇ ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਝਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap071.line04.interpretiveCaution: Both epithets matter. The Punjabi steeks select dissolution of the three worlds for ਤ੍ਰਿਭੰਗੀ and freedom from a bodily limit for ਅਨੰਗੇ. Mahan Kosh cites this exact phrase under a different three-guna reading, involving sattva, rajas and tamas. That alternative remains distinct. Its separate entries about a triple-bent posture or a metre should not automatically replace this contextual reading.

jaap|jaap072.line01.simpleEn: I bow to You, the life within every living being.
jaap|jaap072.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਦੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap072.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਜੀਵ ਜੀਵੰ repeats the language of life to praise its deepest source. Punjabi commentary describes life given to beings; the repeated-noun form also supports life of lives. The line does not divide people into those with more or less spiritual value because of their physical condition.

jaap|jaap072.line02.simpleEn: I bow to You, the source from which every seed receives life.
jaap|jaap072.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੈਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ; ਹਰੇਕ ਬੀਜ ਵਿੱਚ ਉੱਗਣ ਦੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap072.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਬੀਜ ਬੀਜੇ shifts the image from living beings to their beginning or potential. The Punjabi witnesses speak of the cause beneath causes or the power through which seeds sprout. This is an image of originating life, not an agricultural instruction or a promise that every planted seed must grow.

jaap|jaap072.line03.simpleEn: You are never provoked into irritation and remain free of attachment.
jaap|jaap072.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਖਿਝਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਭਿੱਜਦਾ।
jaap|jaap072.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅਖਿੱਜੇ and ਅਭਿੱਜੇ are kept separate. The main reading follows the untroubled and unattached emphasis, alongside Punjabi explanations of not being irritated or emotionally swayed. Mahan Kosh’s ਅਭਿਜ entry cites this Jaap phrase under a fully knowing sense through its ਅਭਿਗ cross-reference; the Bhai Vir Singh-derived page instead gives undivided wholeness. These alternatives need qualified review and should not be merged into one literal gloss.

jaap|jaap072.line04.simpleEn: You are gracious and compassionate toward all.
jaap|jaap072.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਅਤੇ ਦਇਆ ਸਭ ਲਈ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap072.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸਮਸਤੰ keeps the reach universal. ਪ੍ਰਸਿੱਜੇ is explained as being gracious, pleased or compassionate toward all. Read this beside the preceding freedom from agitation or attachment: the pair does not require a picture of an indifferent Divine. Compassion is explicitly present in the line.

jaap|jaap073.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap073.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੰ ਸਰੂਪੇ describes compassion as central to the One being addressed. It continues the graciousness toward all at the end of the previous chhand. The language of ਸਰੂਪ here names a quality rather than assigning the Divine a fixed physical body.

jaap|jaap073.line02.simpleEn: You bring wrongdoing to an end.
jaap|jaap073.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੰਦੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap073.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਕੁਕਰਮੰ names harmful or wrongful actions, and ਪ੍ਰਣਾਸੀ names their ending. The object of the phrase is wrongdoing, not a category of people to be attacked. Beside compassion, the line allows ethical change to be taken seriously without turning it into a warrant for revenge.

jaap|jaap073.line03.simpleEn: All abundance and spiritual powers have their lasting home in You, always and everywhere.
jaap|jaap073.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਰਿੱਧੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਿੱਧੀਆਂ—ਸੰਪਦਾ ਤੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਸ਼ਕਤੀਆਂ—ਸਦਾ ਤੇ ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਟਿਕੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
jaap|jaap073.line03.interpretiveCaution: The whole long line matters: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਬਦਾ stresses abiding presence, ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧੰ names abundance and attainments or extraordinary powers, and ਨਿਵਾਸੀ supplies the dwelling image. Punjabi commentary also brings out presence in every place. The traditional powers are named as dependent on the Divine, not as results promised to a reader; no wealth, miracle or occult ability is guaranteed.

jaap|jaap074.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਮਰ ਹਨ।
jaap|jaap074.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿੱਤ ਕਰਮੇ is provisionally read as deathless deeds, following the Punjabi chapter and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived explanation. Sant Sewa Singh stresses making immortal, while Neki uses nectar-like deeds. The image concerns the character of Divine action; it is not a promise that a human body will avoid death or that created forms never change.

jaap|jaap074.line02.simpleEn: Your dharam is unbroken and unobstructed.
jaap|jaap074.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਧਰਮ ਅਖੰਡ ਹੈ; ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਰੁਕਾਵਟ ਜਾਂ ਟੁੱਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap074.line02.interpretiveCaution: The source says ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ, and that spelling is retained. Mahan Kosh specifically cites ਅੰਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਰਮੇ under unobstructed and unbroken, a sense supported by the Punjabi steeks. Its separate cross-reference to ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤ is not a reason to make these two neighbouring epithets identical or to rewrite the original word.

jaap|jaap074.line03.simpleEn: You are joined with the whole of creation.
jaap|jaap074.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਾਲ ਇੱਕਮਿੱਕ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap074.line03.interpretiveCaution: The source reads ਅਖੱਲ ਜੋਗੇ; another consulted text reads ਅਖਿਲ ਜੋਗੇ. The selected all-inclusive union follows the Punjabi steeks and the dictionary’s ਅਖਲ/ਅਖਿਲ sense of all or whole. The Bhai Vir Singh-derived main wording instead stresses unwavering union, while its note also gives union with everyone. The choice remains provisional; the source word is not normalised.

jaap|jaap074.line04.simpleEn: Your store of sustenance is unfailing.
jaap|jaap074.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰੇ ਅਟੱਲ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਕਦੇ ਮੁੱਕਦੇ ਨਹੀਂ।
jaap|jaap074.line04.interpretiveCaution: The selected ਭੋਗੇ reading concerns unfailing provision: the Punjabi steeks describe enduring supplies or stores. Other consulted explanations emphasise enduring enjoyment or bliss, and Neki uses enduring rule. These are retained as alternatives rather than combined into one literal definition. The devotional image does not promise a person unlimited possessions.

jaap|jaap075.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਜ ਅਡੋਲ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap075.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਚੱਲ ਰਾਜੇ describes enduring Divine rule. The line addresses the One, not a historical regime or a claim that human rulers should never be questioned. The source’s doubled consonant spelling is retained although another consulted text prints ਅਚਲ.

jaap|jaap075.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਸਿਰਜਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਅਟੱਲ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap075.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਸਾਜੇ is read through creation or the power to bring things into being. Punjabi commentary distinguishes steadfast creative power from the preceding sovereignty. ਅਟੱਲ does not require the claim that every created object or arrangement stays unchanged forever.

jaap|jaap075.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap075.line03.interpretiveCaution: The selected reading follows the Punjabi explanation of universal dharam and the dictionary’s all-or-whole sense for ਅਖਲ. Another Punjabi witness and the Bhai Vir Singh-derived page speak of all dharams; Neki emphasises unhindered laws. The source ਅਖੱਲ is preserved. This breadth does not declare every human custom equally wise or erase differences among religious traditions.

jaap|jaap075.line04.simpleEn: Your deeds cannot be fully traced or fathomed.
jaap|jaap075.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਤ ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਸਮਝ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ।
jaap|jaap075.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਲੱਖ ਕਰਮੰ places Divine action beyond complete perception or comprehension. The Punjabi witnesses include unseen deeds and wondrous activity; the other consulted readings stress what cannot be fully known. Humility about understanding is not a reason to stop asking responsible questions about human actions.

jaap|jaap076.line01.simpleEn: You are the giver who sustains every being.
jaap|jaap076.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap076.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਸਰਬੰ gives the address its inclusive reach, while ਦਾਤਾ names giving. The line praises the Divine rather than promising that every personal request will be granted.

jaap|jaap076.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਜਾਣਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap076.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਗਿਆਤਾ names the knower, not merely a collection of information. Divine knowing here does not establish that any human interpreter or teacher knows another person completely.

jaap|jaap076.line03.simpleEn: You are the light through which all things become manifest.
jaap|jaap076.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਪਰਗਟ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਚਾਨਣ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap076.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਭਾਨੇ is read here through radiance and manifestation. This is a working devotional reading of the image, not a scientific assertion about the physical production of light.

jaap|jaap076.line04.simpleEn: You are the honour and greatness present throughout creation.
jaap|jaap076.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਣ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap076.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਮਾਨੇ allows an honour-giving emphasis as well as being honoured by all. The selected explanation follows the former; the latter is praise with universal scope, not a survey of what every person believes.

jaap|jaap077.line01.simpleEn: You are the life that sustains every living being.
jaap|jaap077.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਰੇ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਜੀਵਨ-ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap077.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੰ carries life or life-breath language. The explanation addresses the source of life; it does not prescribe breath retention, a breathing method or a measure of spiritual worth.

jaap|jaap077.line02.simpleEn: You are the refuge and protection of all.
jaap|jaap077.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਅਤੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap077.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਤ੍ਰਾਣੰ adds protection to the preceding life image. Devotional refuge does not imply that people cannot suffer or that practical care and protection are unnecessary.

jaap|jaap077.line03.simpleEn: You are the One who experiences and enjoys all creation.
jaap|jaap077.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਭੋਗਣ ਅਤੇ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap077.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਭੁਗਤਾ is provisionally read as the enjoyer or experiencer. A sustenance-related explanation also occurs in the consulted commentary. These emphases should not be collapsed into a claim that every human appetite is righteous.

jaap|jaap077.line04.simpleEn: You are joined with all and present throughout everything.
jaap|jaap077.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap077.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਜੁਗਤਾ is read here as joined or connected. It completes the movement from life and protection to presence; it is not an instruction for a particular yoga exercise.

jaap|jaap078.line01.simpleEn: You are the radiant Divine presence in all.
jaap|jaap078.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਚਮਕਦੀ ਰੱਬੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap078.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਦੇਵੰ can emphasise radiance or the One worthy of reverence. This explanation selects the radiant-presence sense while retaining the devotional force.

jaap|jaap078.line02.simpleEn: You are the mystery within all that cannot be fully grasped.
jaap|jaap078.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਅੰਦਰ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਉਹ ਭੇਦ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਫੜਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap078.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਭੇਵੰ brings mystery beside the preceding radiance. Being manifest in all and not being exhaustively understood are not treated here as mutually exclusive.

jaap|jaap078.line03.simpleEn: You are the power of time and the ending of all finite life.
jaap|jaap078.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਮੇਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਨਾਸਵੰਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਅੰਤ ਦੀ ਸੱਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap078.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਕਾਲੇ retains the seriousness of time and death. An enduring-presence reading is also recorded in commentary; the main explanation does not quietly remove the ending image.

jaap|jaap078.line04.simpleEn: You are the One who nurtures and sustains all.
jaap|jaap078.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਪਾਲਣ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap078.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਪਾਲੇ answers the preceding ending image with nurture. The two remain side by side; praise of the Divine as the end of life is not permission for a human being to destroy life.

jaap|jaap079.line01.simpleEn: You are the primal reality with no beginning, beyond birth and without limit.
jaap|jaap079.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਦਾ ਮੁੱਢ ਹੈਂ ਪਰ ਆਪ ਮੁੱਢ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ, ਜਨਮ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap079.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਆਦਿ and ਅਨਾਦਿ distinguish being the origin of others from having an origin oneself. ਮੂਰਤਿ here is read as reality or presence, not as requiring an image or a bounded physical body.

jaap|jaap079.line02.simpleEn: Honoured throughout existence, radiant and unfathomable, You are generous from the beginning.
jaap|jaap079.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਮਾਣਯੋਗ, ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਮਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਅਗਾਧ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ; ਆਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਹੀ ਉਦਾਰ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap079.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਤ੍ਰਿਮਾਨ has readings involving honour in three realms or across three times. The main line keeps its comprehensive honour without deciding that difference. ਅਭੇਵ and ਉਦਾਰ retain mystery and generosity rather than becoming names of separate beings.

jaap|jaap079.line03.simpleEn: You sustain all, bring all to dissolution, and are the end of every finite being.
jaap|jaap079.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਪਾਲਦਾ, ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਸਮੇਟਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਨਾਸਵੰਤ ਜੀਵ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap079.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਪਾਲਕ, ਘਾਲਕ and ਕਾਲ must each remain visible. ਘਾਲਕ is selected in its dissolution sense here; a doing or bringing-into-action analysis is also noted in commentary. Neither reading grants human authority over life.

jaap|jaap079.line04.simpleEn: You are present everywhere, unattached yet full of living richness.
jaap|jaap079.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈਂ—ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਵੀ ਅਤੇ ਰਸ ਨਾਲ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਵੀ।
jaap|jaap079.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਅਵਧੂਤ and ਰਿਸਾਲ hold detachment and richness of experience together. The source spells ਰਿਸਾਲ; this explanation does not replace it with another witness’s ਰਸਾਲ or turn detachment into neglect of relationships.

jaap|jaap080.line01.simpleEn: No single name, place, lineage, form, colour or outline can contain You.
jaap|jaap080.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕੋਈ ਇੱਕ ਨਾਮ, ਥਾਂ, ਜਾਤ, ਰੂਪ, ਰੰਗ ਜਾਂ ਰੇਖਾ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੀ।
jaap|jaap080.line01.interpretiveCaution: The list denies limiting classifications. It does not forbid the names used in praise; the act of naming is held together with recognition that a name cannot exhaust what it addresses.

jaap|jaap080.line02.simpleEn: You are the primal, generous presence, unborn and complete without remainder.
jaap|jaap080.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ, ਉਦਾਰ ਹਸਤੀ, ਜਨਮ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਬਪੂਰਨ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap080.line02.interpretiveCaution: The paired ਆਦਿ terms keep the primal sense in view. ਅਸੇਖ is provisionally read as complete or leaving nothing outside; it is not a numerical measurement of the Divine.

jaap|jaap080.line03.simpleEn: No country or costume, shape or mark, and no binding attachment define You.
jaap|jaap080.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਕੋਈ ਦੇਸ, ਭੇਸ, ਰੂਪ, ਰੇਖਾ ਜਾਂ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਗ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਨੂੰ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ।
jaap|jaap080.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਰਾਗ is read here as attachment or attraction rather than as the name of a musical raag. The surrounding list concerns limiting identities, not a rejection of music or of human cultural belonging.

jaap|jaap080.line04.simpleEn: Your loving presence reaches here and there, in every direction and between them.
jaap|jaap080.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਮਈ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਇੱਥੇ-ਉੱਥੇ, ਹਰ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੀਆਂ ਦਿਸ਼ਾਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap080.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਦਿਸਾ ਵਿਸਾ expands the spatial image, while ਅਨੁਰਾਗ introduces love after the preceding denial of binding attachment. The contrast should not be flattened into an instruction to have no affection.

jaap|jaap081.line01.simpleEn: You are beyond a limiting name or desire, and no single dwelling can be assigned to You.
jaap|jaap081.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸੀਮਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈਂ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ ਇੱਕ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਟਿਕਾਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap081.line01.interpretiveCaution: The line concerns how the Divine is apprehended: without a confining name, desire or home. It is not a statement that people should abandon their names, ordinary needs or secure housing.

jaap|jaap081.line02.simpleEn: You are praised as worthy of honour everywhere and always.
jaap|jaap081.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਾਣ ਦੇ ਯੋਗ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap081.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਮਾਨ occurs repeatedly with universal, spatial and enduring force. The line is an act of praise, not evidence that all people actually agree about religion.

jaap|jaap081.line03.simpleEn: Your reality is One, yet You are encountered through the many forms You have made.
jaap|jaap081.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਹਸਤੀ ਇੱਕ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਚੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਝਲਕ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap081.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਏਕ and ਅਨੇਕ create the central contrast. The statement does not rank particular bodies or communities as more Divine than others, nor does it prove any person’s claim to be a Divine incarnation.

jaap|jaap081.line04.simpleEn: You unfold the wondrous play of many forms; when that play is gathered in, the One remains.
jaap|jaap081.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਦੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਖੇਡ ਰਚਦਾ ਹੈਂ; ਖੇਡ ਸਮੇਟੇ ਜਾਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਵੀ ਇੱਕ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap081.line04.interpretiveCaution: The repeated ਖੇਲ is a poetic image for manifestation and its ending. ਅਖੇਲ is difficult to compress into English; the draft preserves wonder rather than claiming a technical cosmological sequence. Calling creation play must not trivialise suffering.

jaap|jaap082.line01.simpleEn: Neither heavenly beings nor the Vedas and other sacred books can fully fathom Your mystery.
jaap|jaap082.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਦੇਵਤੇ, ਵੇਦ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਧਰਮਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਕਿਤਾਬਾਂ ਵੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੇਦ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਣ ਸਕਦੇ।
jaap|jaap082.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਕਤੇਬ extends the reference beyond the Vedas to other scriptural books. The line sets a limit on complete comprehension; it does not tell the reader to mock other traditions or stop learning.

jaap|jaap082.line02.simpleEn: Without a fixed form, colour, caste or lineage, by what outward description could You be completely known?
jaap|jaap082.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਰੂਪ, ਰੰਗ, ਜਾਤ ਜਾਂ ਕੁਲ ਨਹੀਂ; ਕਿਸ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਨਾਲ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਜਾਣੀਏ?
jaap|jaap082.line02.interpretiveCaution: The question turns from a list of absent classifications toward the problem of knowing. ਜੇਬ is provisionally treated as manner or description here; this should not be mistaken for the modern Punjabi word for a pocket.

jaap|jaap082.line03.simpleEn: You have no parents or lineage and are not subject to birth or death.
jaap|jaap082.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੇ ਮਾਤਾ-ਪਿਤਾ ਜਾਂ ਕੁਲ ਨਹੀਂ; ਤੂੰ ਜਨਮ ਅਤੇ ਮਰਨ ਦੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap082.line03.interpretiveCaution: This contrasts Divine existence with inherited identity and mortality. It is not a judgment against parenthood, family ties, birth, ageing or a person’s bodily life.

jaap|jaap082.line04.simpleEn: Your power moves throughout every direction, and the three worlds acknowledge You.
jaap|jaap082.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰੀ ਸੱਤਾ ਚਹੁੰ ਪਾਸੇ ਵਰਤਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਤਿੰਨੇ ਲੋਕ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਮੰਨਦੇ ਹਨ।
jaap|jaap082.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਚੱਕ੍ਰ ਬੱਕ੍ਰ is retained as a difficult movement or ordering image, not silently reduced to a familiar modern phrase. The draft gives its broad contextual force; precise grammar and the source’s ਚਤੁਰ ਚੱਕ form still need qualified review.

jaap|jaap083.line01.simpleEn: Across the fourteen worlds, creation is pictured repeating Your praise.
jaap|jaap083.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਚੌਦਾਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਪ ਕਰਦੀ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਗਈ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap083.line01.interpretiveCaution: The fourteen worlds belong to the poem’s inherited cosmic vocabulary. The draft reads their comprehensive devotional force; it does not present them as a measured astronomical count.

jaap|jaap083.line02.simpleEn: You are the primal Divine presence without beginning, the One who established all that exists.
jaap|jaap083.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਤੇ ਮੁੱਢ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹਸਤੀ ਹੈਂ; ਸਭ ਦੀ ਥਾਪਣਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap083.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਆਦਿ and ਅਨਾਦਿ again distinguish the origin of creation from an origin imposed on the Divine. The repeated ਥਾਪ forms emphasise establishing rather than a human act of building an object.

jaap|jaap083.line03.simpleEn: You are supreme and pure, complete in presence and without limit.
jaap|jaap083.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਪਰਮ ਅਤੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਹੈਂ; ਤੇਰੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਸਰਬਪੂਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਹੈ।
jaap|jaap083.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਰੂਪ, ਮੂਰਤਿ and ਪੁਰਖ are read together as descriptions of Divine reality. Their presence here does not require a fixed physical outline after earlier stanzas deny such limits.

jaap|jaap083.line04.simpleEn: Self-existent, You fashioned the whole universe and are its maker and dissolver.
jaap|jaap083.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਤੋਂ ਹੈਂ; ਸਾਰਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਰਚਣ, ਘੜਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਮੇਟਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap083.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਸੁਯੰਭਵ is read as self-existent, with no prior maker. ਗੜਨ and ਭੰਜਨ retain making and dissolution as distinct acts. The wording is devotional cosmology, not a scientific account of how the universe developed.

jaap|jaap084.line01.simpleEn: Beyond time and death, endowed with power, You are the timeless presence not confined to a country.
jaap|jaap084.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਕਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ, ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਨਾਲ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap084.line01.interpretiveCaution: ਅਦੇਸ is selected as not limited to a particular place. An address of salutation is another recorded reading. ਕਾਲ ਹੀਨ and ਅਕਾਲ must not be turned into a promise of bodily immortality for the reader.

jaap|jaap084.line02.simpleEn: You are the ground of dharam, free from delusion, beyond material confinement, sight and outward guise.
jaap|jaap084.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰ, ਭਰਮ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ, ਭੌਤਿਕ ਹੱਦਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ, ਅਲੱਖ ਅਤੇ ਭੇਸ ਤੋਂ ਮੁਕਤ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap084.line02.interpretiveCaution: ਅਭੂਤ is provisionally read as beyond material or elemental confinement, alongside the unseeable and guiseless terms. Incomparability is another commentary emphasis; the list should not be compressed to only one quality.

jaap|jaap084.line03.simpleEn: No bodily adornment, colour, caste, lineage or limiting name can define You.
jaap|jaap084.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਰੀਰਕ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ, ਰੰਗ, ਜਾਤ, ਕੁਲ ਜਾਂ ਸੀਮਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੱਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap084.line03.interpretiveCaution: ਅੰਗ ਰਾਗ is provisionally grouped as bodily colour or adornment. Other analyses separate body and attachment. Neither makes ordinary bodily appearance a measure of anyone’s spiritual worth.

jaap|jaap084.line04.simpleEn: You humble pride, overcome wickedness, and act as the giver of liberation.
jaap|jaap084.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਤੋੜਦਾ, ਦੁਸ਼ਟਤਾ ਦਾ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
jaap|jaap084.line04.interpretiveCaution: ਗਰਬ and ਦੁਸਟ distinguish pride from harmful conduct, while ਮੁਕਤਿ adds liberation. ਕਾਮ is read as work or function in this phrase, not automatically as the desire sense found in other contexts.

jaap|jaap085.line01.simpleEn: Your own reality is unfathomably deep, beyond complete praise: the One, present yet unattached.
jaap|jaap085.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਗਾਧ ਹੈ; ਪੂਰੀ ਉਸਤਤ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ, ਇੱਕ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
